title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Exhibition Hall on 1968-12-21
lineage: SBD cassette master > cassette > DAT/0 > CDR/0 > CDR/1 > iMac > SHN

ai_review.summary: A hissy low‑level soundboard captures a fiery 1968 freak‑out set highlighted by the Alligator > Caution jam and other intense improvisations.
ai_review.review: Despite noticeable hiss, low volume and occasional tape degradation, this SBD recording delivers an electrifying ’68 performance. Reviewers rave about the blazing Alligator > Caution sequence (with a possible Eleven interlude), the high‑energy “Bid You Goodnight” from Feedback, and the overall fire in the band’s playing.

ai_rating.rationale: Nine detailed reviews mostly rate the show 4‑5 stars; comments praise the musical intensity while noting only modest sound quality issues, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low overall levels, noticeable hiss and some tape degradation; however the recording remains listenable and captures the band’s dynamics despite the modest fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fast‑paced, intense early‑'68 freak‑out set with seamless segues and high‑energy improvisations that keep the momentum rolling throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned as part of the vocal sections (WBYG) and integral to the jam energy; no specific guitar critique.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for his fiery bass playing and participation in the WBYG vocals.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums highlighted in the Alligator > The Eleven transition, driving the intensity of the improvisations.
